metaDescription: Order custom orange lanyards for events or safety. Durable, bulk options with full-color printing. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Orange lanyards are a popular choice for safety visibility and event coordination. Whether you need high-visibility lanyards for construction site access or bright orange IDs for a festival, these lanyards stand out. Available in widths from 3/8" to 1", with options like woven or silkscreened imprinting. Pair with a lobster clip for easy attachment. Custom orange lanyards keep your team identifiable and organized.
